items.stem: What most clearly distinguishes threat hunting from standard alert monitoring?

options.text: Hunting proactively searches for threats that no alert has flagged
options.rationale: Correct: hunting is hypothesis-driven and proactive, not alert-driven.

options.text: Hunting only reviews alerts the SIEM already produced
options.rationale: Reviewing existing alerts is monitoring, not hunting.

options.text: Hunting requires no data at all
Hunting can only be done by automated tools
options.rationale: Hunting is analyst-led, though tools assist.

items.explanation: Correct: hunting proactively seeks un-alerted threats via hypotheses.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO make a threat-hunting hypothesis effective? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It is grounded in a specific adversary technique
options.rationale: Correct: a technique-based hypothesis is concrete and testable.

options.text: It is scoped to data you can actually query
options.rationale: Correct: a testable scope keeps the hunt achievable.

options.text: It is as broad as 'find all bad things'
options.rationale: An unbounded hypothesis cannot be tested or concluded.

options.text: It avoids referencing any data source
options.rationale: A hypothesis you cannot query against cannot be tested.

items.explanation: Correct: a technique-grounded, queryable scope makes a hypothesis effective.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A hunt confirms malicious use of an admin tool. What is the most valuable next step?

options.text: Create a detection so the behaviour is caught automatically in future
options.rationale: Correct: operationalising the finding gives lasting value.

options.text: Delete the logs that revealed it
options.rationale: Deleting evidence undermines response and future detection.

options.text: Stop hunting because the job is done
options.rationale: Hunts should feed continuous improvement, not end coverage.

options.text: Keep the finding secret from responders
options.rationale: Responders need the finding to act.

items.explanation: Correct: turning the finding into a detection makes it catch the behaviour next time.
